description: Side drawer showing the Gantt audit log with time-travel and rollback.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Fires when the drawer should close.

parameters.name: OnRollbackRequested
parameters.description: Fires when the user requests rollback to a specific history entry.

parameters.name: OnTimeTravelRequested
parameters.description: Fires when the user requests time-travel to a specific timestamp.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: Zone the entry timestamps are shown in. Defaults to the machine's local zone; TmGantt passes the user's display zone.
